title: Woah Where am I

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Uh, I'm, hold on, I know this. Something is telling me Sage something. Why am I thinking about burning herbs and smokey rooms?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh, I'm, hold on, I know this. Something is telling me Sage something. Why am I thinking about burning herbs and smokey rooms?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Maybe! You act like you've never escaped from a clandestine government facility before! Wait!!! My wristband. My name must be on my--John Doe. Who the fuck is John Doe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe! You act like you've never escaped from a clandestine government facility before! Wait!!! My wristband. My name must be on my--John Doe. Who the fuck is John Doe?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Wow, I had no idea my parents were so uncreative. Like ZEEERRROOO imagination, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow, I had no idea my parents were so uncreative. Like ZEEERRROOO imagination, huh?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: You mean the CorpSec facility analyzing the tensile strength of space-time fabric?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean the CorpSec facility analyzing the tensile strength of space-time fabric?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: It's hidden, like all the eyes on us right now. Watching. Always watching. You shoulda seen what I had to do to get outta there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hidden, like all the eyes on us right now. Watching. Always watching. You shoulda seen what I had to do to get outta there.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: I was recruited into a study to determine the possibility of utilizing advanced perception techniques on time manipulation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was recruited into a study to determine the possibility of utilizing advanced perception techniques on time manipulation.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: First, I befriended one of the research specialists. Got him drunk on bio-wine I found in a beaker. BAM!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First, I befriended one of the research specialists. Got him drunk on bio-wine I found in a beaker. BAM!

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: I do what I do because I'm--uh--hold on... Oh, right! John Doe. I'm THE John Doe. Climber of scaffolding. Traveler of time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do what I do because I'm--uh--hold on... Oh, right! John Doe. I'm THE John Doe. Climber of scaffolding. Traveler of time.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Nor should you! I was sworn to secrecy so there is an overwhelmingly good chance that everything I told you is a lie. You know, for your own protection and all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nor should you! I was sworn to secrecy so there is an overwhelmingly good chance that everything I told you is a lie. You know, for your own protection and all.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: One and the same! I do what I do because I'm--uh--hold on... Oh, right! John Doe. I'm THE John Doe. Climber of scaffolding. Traveler of time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One and the same! I do what I do because I'm--uh--hold on... Oh, right! John Doe. I'm THE John Doe. Climber of scaffolding. Traveler of time.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Took my chance, snipped the lift cables and climbed through a vent. I was unstoppable. You know, unless they found and then stopped me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Took my chance, snipped the lift cables and climbed through a vent. I was unstoppable. You know, unless they found and then stopped me.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: And now I'm off before the cameras catch too much of this scene. FFFRRREEEDDOOOMMM!!!!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And now I'm off before the cameras catch too much of this scene. FFFRRREEEDDOOOMMM!!!!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I think that's what the place called you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I think that's what the place called you.
